tables.title: Description of the processing under consideration

initial_rows.description: Appdaemon is a local automation runtime deployed in a Smartotum smart home. It executes user-defined automation scripts triggered by home events (e.g., sensors, device state changes, schedules) and can issue commands to devices through Smartotum controllers.
initial_rows.purposes: Provide the home automation service requested by the user (event-driven and scheduled actions), support safety and comfort (e.g., alerts, presence-based automations), and ensure reliability through operational logging and troubleshooting.
initial_rows.stakes: Home events and automation logs can reveal personal habits (presence and routines). Unauthorized access or misconfiguration could lead to privacy breaches or unsafe device actions.
initial_rows.controller: Household Data Controller (the Primary Data Controller of the application in the Privacy Dashboard).
initial_rows.processor: Smartotum local controllers running Appdaemon and connected services (e.g., Home Assistant), operating within the smart home.

tables.title: Sector-specific standards applicable to the processing

initial_rows.standards: GDPR principles (lawfulness, transparency, minimization, storage limitation); CNIL PIA methodology; OWASP recommendations for web/API security (as guidance).
initial_rows.consideration: Used as reference to define privacy-by-design and security-by-design controls. The deployment follows a local-first approach where possible.

initial_rows.storage_duration: Stored while the application is installed and the smart home is managed; removed on uninstall/account deletion

initial_rows.data_types: Automation configuration (scripts, schedules, thresholds, policy settings)
initial_rows.storage_duration: Stored until modified or the application is removed

initial_rows.data_types: Operational events and logs (timestamps, triggers executed, error messages)
initial_rows.recipients: Data Controller for troubleshooting; local controllers

initial_rows.data_supporting_assets: Smartotum DHT, home network (Wi-Fi/Ethernet), local controller

Send commands to devices via Smartotum controllers (e.g., switch on/off, start/stop actions)

tables.title: Explanation and justification of lawfulness

initial_rows.justification: Where processing goes beyond what is strictly necessary for core automation, it is enabled only after explicit consent in the Privacy Dashboard. Consent can be withdrawn at any time.

initial_rows.lawfulness_criteria: Processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is party or in order to take steps at the request of the data subject prior to entering into a contract
initial_rows.justification: Processing is required to execute the automation service requested by the Data Subject (event ingestion, rule execution, and device control).

initial_rows.lawfulness_criteria: Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject
initial_rows.justification: No specific legal obligation has been identified for this prototype.

initial_rows.lawfulness_criteria: Processing is necessary in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of another natural person
initial_rows.justification: Not designed for emergency medical processing; safety automations are user-configured.

initial_rows.lawfulness_criteria: Processing is necessary for the performance of a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller
initial_rows.justification: Not applicable.

initial_rows.lawfulness_criteria: Processing is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the controller or by a third party, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject which require protection of personal data, in particular where the data subject is a child
initial_rows.justification: Limited operational monitoring and logs are processed to ensure security and availability. Data is minimized and retained for a limited time.

tables.title: Description and assessment of controls implemented for treating the risks related to data security

columns.label: Controls bearing specifically on the data being processed

initial_rows.implementation_or_justification: Communications use HTTPS/TLS in transit. Data is stored locally where possible; disk-level encryption is recommended for the controller host. Access tokens are required for Smartotum DHT access.
initial_rows.corrective_controls: Enforce encryption-at-rest requirements in deployment guidelines

initial_rows.implementation_or_justification: Device UUIDs are used as pseudonymous identifiers. Automation logs avoid storing sensitive payloads beyond what is required for troubleshooting.

initial_rows.controls_data_processed: Data partitioning (in relation to the rest of the information system)
initial_rows.implementation_or_justification: Processing is scoped per smart home. Services can be containerized and isolated from the rest of the home network. Access controls prevent cross-home data access.
Role-based access control is enforced (Data Subject, Data Controller, DPO). Authenticated sessions and bearer tokens are required for protected operations.
Actions such as consent changes and rule changes are logged with timestamps. Operational logs are rotated and retained for a limited time.
Input validation is applied on API requests and configuration updates. Backups support recovery from accidental or malicious changes.
initial_rows.corrective_controls: Add automated integrity checks for critical configuration files

initial_rows.implementation_or_justification: Archiving is disabled by default; if enabled, access is restricted and retention is limited
Not applicable (digital-only processing)

Automated backups with rotation; restore procedure tested periodically
Maintenance access limited to authorized users; changes tracked and reviewed

Basic monitoring and alerting for service failures; logs reviewed for anomalies
Controller hardware kept in a secure location within the home; physical access limited
Secure configuration of the host device; disk encryption recommended; secure backups
Stable power/network; optional UPS; safe placement of hardware

initial_rows.implementation_or_justification: Basic environmental protections (heat, humidity, fire safety) as per home deployment
